{{Infobox mineral |name = Prismatic Shard |image = Prismatic Shard.png |source = [[Mining]] • [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] • [[Monsters]]' drop • [[Omni Geode|Omni Geodes]] • [[Rainbow Trout]] [[Fish Pond]]s • [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|Treasure room]] • [[Statue Of True Perfection]] • [[Random Events#Meteorite|Meteorite]] • [[Mystery Box]] • [[Golden Mystery Box]] • [[Statue Of Blessings|Prismatic Butterfly]] |sellprice = 2000 |profession = y }} The '''Prismatic Shard''' is a [[Minerals|Mineral]]. It is one of the rarest items in the game, and has a variety of uses, including obtaining the [[Galaxy Sword]]. ==Locations== Prismatic shards can be found in: * 25% chance from a [[Mining#Mystic Stone|Mystic Stone]] in [[the Mines]] at floors 100+, [[Skull Cavern]], [[Quarry]], and [[Volcano Dungeon]]. * 25% chance from a [[Random Events#Meteorite|meteorite]]. * 1/26 (≈3.8%) chance from a [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure room]] in the Skull Cavern. * 3.5% chance from an [[Mining#Iridium Node|Iridium Node]] in the [[Skull Cavern]], [[Quarry]] and [[Volcano Dungeon]]. * 0.4% chance from an [[Omni Geode]]. * 0.4% chance from a [[Mystery Box]]. * 0.1% chance from [[Serpent]]s and [[Mummy|Mummies]] (and their dangerous variants). 0.05% chance from [[Shadow Brute]]s and [[Shadow Shaman]] (and their dangerous variants). * 0.1% chance from [[Wilderness Golem]]s and [[Iridium Golem]]s after reaching [[Combat]] Level 10. * 0.79% chance from a [[Golden Mystery Box]]. * 0.09% daily chance from a [[Rainbow Trout]] [[Fish Pond]] with a population of at least 9. * 0.05% chance from any [[Monsters|monster]] after the player has reached the bottom of [[the Mines]]. * ≈0.012% chance from a [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chest]] after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|fishing level 6]]. * One in a chest at the top of the [[Volcano Dungeon]] the first time the player arrives there. * Once per day from the [[Statue Of True Perfection]]. * Purchased from [[Emily]] for {{Price|500|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s when she hosts a [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] during the [[Desert Festival]]. * From the [[Statue Of Blessings#List of Blessings|Blessing Of The Butterfly]] (up to a 17.5% chance). ==Uses== * A Prismatic Shard can be used in [[the Desert]] to obtain the [[Galaxy Sword]]. The [[Graveyard#Dwarvish Headstone|Dwarvish Headstone]] in the graveyard contains a riddle explaining how to obtain it. * A Prismatic Shard is one of the options used to complete [[Bundles#The Missing Bundle|the Missing Bundle]] to unlock the [[Movie Theater]]. * A Prismatic Shard can be offered to the [[Dark Shrine of Selfishness]] at the [[Witch's Hut]] to turn [[children]] into doves (getting rid of them permanently). * On [[Days of the Week#Thursday|Thursdays]] the [[Desert Trader]] sells 1 [[Magic Rock Candy]] for 3 Prismatic Shards. * Prismatic Shards are used to enchant tools in the [[Forge]]. * A Prismatic Shard can be placed into a [[Junimo Hut]] to cause the [[Junimos|Junimo]] to cycle through the rainbow resembling a Prismatic Shard. * A Prismatic Shard can be donated to [[Gunther]] at the [[Museum]]. * A Prismatic Shard can be used in the [[Sewing Machine]] to create prismatic clothing (see [[#Tailoring|Tailoring]] below). * Prismatic Shards can be [[Friendship#Gifts|gifted]] as a universally loved gift (to everyone except [[Haley]]). *[[Multiplayer]] only: A Prismatic Shard can be used to craft a [[Wedding Ring]] to propose marriage to another player. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |love=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Leo |hate=Haley }} ==Bundles== One Prismatic Shard is an option for {{Bundle|Missing||y}}. ==Recipes== {| class="wikitable" !Image !Name !Description !Ingredients !Recipe Source |- |[[File:Wedding Ring.png|center]] |[[Wedding Ring]] |{{Description|Wedding Ring}}
